x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, leaf-integrations (REQ-LEAF-005, REQ-LEAF-006). The Mail sidebar offers a schema for linking only when its configuration.linkedTypes names `mail` (the id OpenRegister's sidebar filters on and its LinkedTypesRule accepts), so the four schemas that already show an email or files surface declare it, making the email tabs two-sided. Only Decision declares a mail object template: a mail-born decision is a draft resolution, inert until a person advances it. ActionItem must not declare one either: it is a read-only projection of CalDAV VTODOs, so a create-from-email button there could never save.
